sources.label: Spiko SICAV prospectus, 1 September 2026, SAFO redemption cap pages 61–63

reserveReview.rationale: GBP overnight swap fund-share identity and BNP Paribas are disclosed. The September 2026 prospectus permits bonds, equities and money-market instruments under TRS. Ordinary redemptions settle D+1 business day after a 15:00 Paris cutoff, but the same share claim is subject to gates at 25% net redemptions, carried-over orders without priority, and up to 20 valuation days of capping over three months. The conservative whole-claim liquidity horizon is therefore over-seven-days, not an unconditional one-day stress realization guarantee. No composition weights or composition date were refreshed by this metadata-only review.
